special_rules.name: HomeRunHazard
special_rules.rule: copy only his biggest NBA spread position per game when it is >= 1.2x his usual size, even if he holds both sides; fee-free resting order at or below his entry; never mirror his two-sided book
special_rules.source: bt/hrh_results.md backtest (236 NBA spread games, Oct 3 - Nov 11 2026)
